title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' Anime Project in Production
content: The Dover Street Market Ginza Open House public event announced on Friday that a new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) anime project is in production, revealing an announcement visual (pictured). Animation studio Science SARU will be producing the new anime project.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Made in Abyss Theatrical Series Part 2 Announced, New Key Visual Revealed
content: The second installment in the new Made in Abyss theatrical series is officially in production, continuing the story after the first film, Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery ). The first film opened in Japan on October 23, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Science Saru's The Ghost in the Shell Gets New Anime Project
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Friday that a new anime project is underway for The Ghost in the Shell ( Kōkaku Kidōtai THE GHOST IN THE SHELL ) television anime from Science SARU . The announcement did not state the format of the new anime, but confirmed Science SARU will again animate the work.
author: ANN

title: Shōya Ishige Joins Cast of Wound & Bandage TV Anime
content: The official website for television anime of Umihoshi Nanai 's Wound & Bandage ( Kizuguchi to Hōtai ) manga streamed a second teaser promotional video on Friday, which reveals that Shōya Ishige will voice Ginsuke Hatobane in the series.
author: ANN

title: New Votoms Anime Films' Teaser Reveals Theme Song
content: The staff for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise , unveiled a new visual and teaser trailer for the films on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi Anime Film Reveals 4 Cast Members
content: The staff of Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film series , unveiled a new visual and more cast members for the film on Friday, the same day as the film's opening .
author: ANN

title: Exclusive: Nakama Press Licenses Uoto's 100 Meters, Buichi Terasawa's Goku Midnight Eye Manga for Release in 2027
content: Mad Cave Studios' imprint Nakama Press announced on Thursday that it has licensed Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga, and will release the first two volumes in 2027. Nakama Press will release the manga's first volume on February 17 and the second volume on April 27.
author: ANN

title: 'Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi' Movie Second Part Announced
content: The official website of the Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery ) movie announced the production of a second part on Friday, as well as five additional cast and a second key visual (pictured) for the first movie. The first part premiered in Japan on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Cosplay Trackside Returns to Santa Anita Park on October 24 & 25
content: Cosplay Trackside, an Umamusume- themed cosplay meetup, returns to Santa Anita Park in Arcadia, California, on October 24 and 25, from 12:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. The event coincides with Santa Anita Park’s Japan Family Day, celebrating the racecourse’s partnership with Japan’s Oi Racetrack.
author: Anime Corner

title: Frequent Ghibli Collaborator Joe Hisaishi Named LA Philharmonic's Composer-in-Residence
content: Hisaishi's new role will include composing new works specifically for the orchestra. He will also hold recurring performances at the Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and the Walt Disney Concert Hall in Los Angeles.
author: ANN
